H4099.name: Hammedatha
H4099.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4099.brief: The father of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.
H4099.short: Hammedatha was the father of Haman, the Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews in the book of Esther.

H4060G.name: huge man
H4060G.desc: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
H4060G.brief: A huge man from Gath, killed by David's warriors.
H4060G.short: A huge man from Gath, possibly a descendant of the Rephaim, was killed by David's warriors during a battle with the Philistines.

H4074G.name: Madai
H4074G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4074G.brief: Son of Japheth; progenitor of the Medes
H4074G.short: Madai, a son of Japheth, is considered the ancestor of the Medes.

H4089H.name: Madmannah
H4089H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4089H.brief: Descendant of Caleb, son of Hezron
H4089H.short: Madmannah was a descendant of Caleb, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah.

H4025.name: Magdiel
H4025.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4025.short: Magdiel was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau, the son of Isaac.

H4031G.name: Magog
H4031G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4031G.brief: Son of Japheth; progenitor of a people group
H4031G.short: Magog, a son of Japheth, is considered the ancestor of a people group mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy.

H4047.name: Magpiash
H4047.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4047.brief: One who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H4047.short: Magpiash was among those who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H4091.name: Medan
H4091.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4091.short: Medan was a son of Abraham and his concubine Keturah.

H4006.name: Mibhar
H4006.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4006.brief: One of David's mighty warriors, son of Hagri.
H4006.short: Mibhar, the son of Hagri, was one of David's mighty warriors.

H4017H.name: Mibsam
H4017H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4017H.short: Mibsam, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Mishma.

H4017G.name: Mibsam
H4017G.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4017G.brief: Son of Ishmael, grandson of Abraham.
H4017G.short: Mibsam was a son of Ishmael and grandson of Abraham.

H4014.name: Mibzar
H4014.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4014.brief: A chief of Edom, descendant of Esau.
H4014.short: Mibzar was one of the chiefs of Edom, descended from Esau.

H4080G.name: Midian
H4080G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4080G.brief: Son of Abraham and Keturah; father of the Midianites.
H4080G.short: Midian, a son of Abraham and Keturah, was the ancestor of the Midianite people.

H4089G.name: Madmannah
H4089G.brief: A town in the Negev of Judah
H4089G.short: Madmannah (Beth-marcaboth), a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:31; 19:5; 1Ch.4.31">Joshua 15:31; 19:5; 1Ch.4.31</ref>).

H4086.name: Madmen
H4086.brief: A place in Moab threatened with destruction
H4086.short: Madmen, a place in Moab against which Jeremiah prophesied destruction (<ref="Jeremiah 48:2">Jeremiah 48:2</ref>).

H4088.name: Madmenah
H4088.short: Madmenah, a place near Jerusalem mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy (<ref="Isaiah 10:31">Isaiah 10:31</ref>).

H4068.name: Madon
H4068.brief: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
H4068.short: Madon, a Canaanite city whose king joined a coalition against Joshua but was defeated (<ref="Joshua 11:1; 12:19">Joshua 11:1; 12:19</ref>).

H4019.name: Magbish
H4019.brief: A place whose people returned from Babylonian exile
H4019.short: Magbish, a place whose people are listed among those who returned to Judah from Babylonian exile (<ref="Ezra 2:30">Ezra 2:30</ref>).

H4031H.name: Magog
H4031H.brief: A nation that will attack Israel in the future
H4031H.short: Magog, a nation that will join forces with Gog to attack Israel in the future, as prophesied in Ezekiel and Revelation (<ref="Ezk.38.2; 39:6; Revelation 20:8">Ezk.38.2; 39:6; Revelation 20:8</ref>).

H4074H.name: Media
H4074H.brief: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire
H4074H.short: Media (Medes), an ancient kingdom in western Iran that, along with Persia, conquered Babylon and formed the Persian Empire (<ref="2Ki.17.6; 18:11; Esther 1:3, 14, 18; 10:2; Isaiah 21:2; Jeremiah 25:25; Dan.8.20">2Ki.17.6; 18:11; Esther 1:3, 14, 18; 10:2; Isaiah 21:2; Jeremiah 25:25; Dan.8.20</ref>).

H4023.name: Megiddo
H4023.brief: A strategic city in the Jezreel Valley
H4023.short: Megiddo, a strategically important city in the Jezreel Valley (<ref="Joshua 12:21; 17:11; Judges 1:27; 5:19">Joshua 12:21; 17:11; Judges 1:27; 5:19</ref>), fortified by Solomon (<ref="1Ki.9.15">1Ki.9.15</ref>), and the site of King Josiah's death (<ref="2Ki.23.29-30; 2Ch.35.22">2Ki.23.29-30; 2Ch.35.22</ref>).

H4081.name: Middin
H4081.brief: A town in the wilderness of Judah
H4081.short: Middin, a town in the wilderness of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:61">Joshua 15:61</ref>).

H4080H.name: Midian
H4080H.brief: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges
H4080H.short: Midian, a nation descended from Abraham through Keturah (<ref="Genesis 25:2">Genesis 25:2</ref>), which oppressed Israel during the time of the judges (Judges 6-8) and was later defeated by Gideon (Judges 7-8).

H4027.name: Migdal-el
H4027.short: Migdal-el, a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 19:38">Joshua 19:38</ref>).

H4028.name: Migdal-gad
H4028.brief: A town in the lowlands of Judah
H4028.short: Migdal-gad, a town in the lowlands of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:37">Joshua 15:37</ref>).

H4024B.name: Migdol
H4024B.brief: A place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped
H4024B.short: Migdol, a place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped during the Exodus (<ref="Exodus 14:2; Numbers 33:7">Exodus 14:2; Numbers 33:7</ref>), and a city in Egypt mentioned in prophecies (<ref="Jeremiah 44:1; 46:14; Ezk.29.10; 30:6">Jeremiah 44:1; 46:14; Ezk.29.10; 30:6</ref>).

H4051.name: Migron
H4051.brief: A place near Gibeah where Saul camped
H4051.short: Migron, a place near Gibeah where Saul camped with his troops (<ref="1Sa.14.2">1Sa.14.2</ref>), and a town mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy about the Assyrian invasion (<ref="Isaiah 10:28">Isaiah 10:28</ref>).

H4057G.name: Sinai Wilderness
H4057G.brief: Wilderness where Israel camped after leaving Egypt
H4057G.short: The Sinai Wilderness was the region where the Israelites camped after the Exodus and received the Law.

H4029.name: Tower of Eder
H4029.brief: A tower near Bethlehem, associated with the Messiah
H4029.short: The Tower of Eder, a watchtower near Bethlehem, where Jacob pitched his tent and later associated with the coming of the Messiah (<ref="Gen. 35:21; Mic. 4:8">Gen. 35:21; Mic. 4:8</ref>).

H4026H.name: Tower of the Hundred
H4026H.brief: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
H4026H.short: The Tower of the Hundred, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's restoration of the city (<ref="Neh. 3:1; 12:39">Neh. 3:1; 12:39</ref>).

H4026I.name: Tower of the Ovens
H4026I.brief: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
H4026I.short: The Tower of the Ovens, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's restoration of the city (<ref="Neh. 3:11; 12:38">Neh. 3:11; 12:38</ref>).
